failureModes.MODEL_CAPABILITY_LIMIT: Earlier direct and separated Basic Pitch evidence lacked reliable pitch/role authority; routing could not recover missing evidence.
failureModes.DOMAIN_TRANSFER_LIMIT: GAPS improved isolated guitar but did not transfer consistently to dense metal.
failureModes.ROBUSTNESS_LIMIT: MuScriptor's strong aggregate gain was not robust to the frozen layered-melodic texture.
failureModes.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: HiMMP establishes real kick timing only; no rights-cleared real full pitched-metal reference was available.
failureModes.RIGHTS_LIMIT: Protected commercial references remained evaluation-only and were never generation or tuning inputs.
failureModes.LICENSE_LIMIT: MuScriptor weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and cannot enter the production product.
failureModes.DOWNSTREAM_LIMIT: Earlier learner outputs lost much of the available evidence; MuScriptor downstream was not evaluated because its raw contract failed.
failureModes.RESOURCE_LIMIT: CLaMP3 was stopped before evaluation at its bounded resource gate; this was not a quality result.

materialTriggers: A commercially usable model publishes multi-instrument dense-rock or dense-metal evidence materially beyond the frozen MuScriptor result.
MuScriptor or a successor becomes production-license compatible and a new frozen architecture or version addresses layered-texture regression.
A fundamentally different transcription architecture presents credible real-recording dense-metal evidence.
Keyspilli obtains a substantially stronger rights-cleared real-metal full-reference benchmark.
